scope: Calibrate a specified stationary QVI boundary and preserve one receiver input in its declared two-neuron diagnostic, under the original continuous recurrence; no labeled retrieval data.
arms: joint LBFGS BP from same initial
objective: squared source-boundary discrepancy plus squared receiver start discrepancy on anchor
timing: single CPU thread, same framework, warm one unmeasured complete paired run; five timed alternating pairs, include common baseline, goal derivation, edit, three off-anchor evaluations and final validation; count optimization closures, never infer task-training time
off_anchor: report every held initial; no fitting, no selection and no off-anchor pass requirement
